name: INCLO Google TV 4K (KTC, Realtek, khardi, KTC_INCLO_4K_EU_23GV1), Taiwan
warnings: The Netflix and YouTube buttons go out over IR as KTC keycodes 3001/3003 and are consumed by com.realtek.keyintercept, which on Google TV only broadcasts com.google.global_button.ACTION_LAUNCH_APP to launcherx: with launcherx disabled they do nothing, and no key helper sees them.

Kept: all com.realtek.* TV/input packages; com.realsil.ota (remote firmware updater, RcuUpdate); KTC factory packages com.kgzn.serialport and com.kgzn.tvfactory (global key receivers, never launched); Chromecast; voice (katniss, tv.remote.service); YouTube Music, karaoke, the ambient screensaver, TalkBack by choice.
